sections.content: To tell a friend or family member to do something (informal 'tú'), use the affirmative imperative. For regular verbs, this form is identical to the 3rd person singular (él/ella) of the present indicative.

items.spanish: Carlos, habla más despacio, por favor.
Come tus verduras antes del postre.
Escribe tu nombre en la lista.
items.english: Write your name on the list.

sections.content: Stem-changing verbs keep their stem change in the affirmative tú imperative: cerrar → cierra, volver → vuelve, pedir → pide.
